title: 7 things that fixed my 2am scrolling
format: Notes listicle, app on one point
why: Real fixes earn the one confession slide; the app is the "what actually worked".
caption: number 4 is cheating but it works. which one would you try? #screentimehacks #sleep
check: every point must be true for you

slides.heading: _boring_ beats blocked
slides.top: i stopped trying to fight the urge and started making bed _boring_
slides.text:
a paper book on the pillow

nothing to scroll, so the brain gives up

slides.heading: the charger _moved rooms_
slides.top: if it charges by the bed, it _ends up in the bed_
slides.text:
kitchen counter, every night

the walk back is long enough to change my mind

slides.heading: my apps _go to sleep_
slides.top: this is the one that actually stuck
slides.text:
at 11 my apps sleep and _don't wake up until i've walked_ in the morning

willpower at 1am is not a plan

slides.heading: lights _down at 10_
slides.top: ceiling lights off, one lamp on
slides.text:
my brain stopped thinking it was noon

i got sleepy before midnight for the first time in years
